plans.title: Plans
editor.title: Plan editor
editor.portionHint: Type a target and press Enter to re-portion.
editor.macrosHint: Auto-calculated from the ingredients — edit to override. Calories follow the macros.
editor.noNutrition: No nutrition data — its calories/macros can't be recalculated
editor.mealSaved: Meal saved to your gym's library
editor.applyDistributionHint: Rebalances every meal to sum to the daily target.
editor.distributed: Meals rebalanced to the daily target
editor.macroSumWarning: Macro percentages add up to {sum}% (should be 100%).
editor.removeMealConfirm: Remove this whole meal and its options?
editor.subtitle: Subtitle (e.g. Choose One)
editor.check.dailyMismatch: Daily total from meals is {sum} kcal but the header shows {daily} kcal — click "Distribute & rescale" in Plan settings to rebalance.
editor.check.optionSpread: Options in one meal vary by {spread} kcal — they may not be interchangeable.
editor.check.carbRange: {count} option(s) in this meal are outside the {range} g carb range for the client's blood-sugar condition.
editor.check.carbSpread: Carbs vary by {spread} g between options in this meal. For blood-sugar control they should be closer.
editor.check.fatHigh: {count} option(s) in this meal are over the {cap} g fat limit for the client's condition.
editor.check.proteinLow: {count} option(s) in this meal are under the {min} g protein minimum for the client's diabetes.
editor.check.hyperthyroidReview: Hyperthyroidism: calorie needs are often higher and change with treatment. Check the daily target before approving.
editor.check.fatShareHigh: {count} option(s) in this meal get more than {share}% of their calories from fat (high blood pressure limit).
editor.check.powderHigh: A typical day can reach {scoops} scoops of protein powder. Vegan plans should stay at 2 or fewer.
editor.check.macroMismatch: "{option}" macros don't reconcile with its calories.
editor.check.duplicateAcrossMeals: "{option}" is offered in more than one meal ({meals}) — the client would see the same dish twice.
editor.check.duplicateInMeal: "{option}" is listed twice in the same meal.
editor.check.portionHigh: "{ingredient}" in "{option}" is {grams} g — that may be too large a serving.
editor.check.portionLow: "{ingredient}" in "{option}" is {grams} g — that may be too small a serving.
editor.check.heavyPlate: "{option}" totals {grams} g of food — that may be too much for one plate.
editor.check.recompLowProtein: Shape Up plan: a typical day gives about {protein} g of protein, below the {min} g minimum (1.6 g/kg). Swap in higher-protein options.
editor.check.recompInactive: Shape Up plan for a client who reported little or no exercise — building muscle needs regular strength training. Confirm the goal with the client.
editor.approveSubtitle: This is the final approval — your sign-off is printed on the client's plan and it becomes ready to send.
editor.approveDateNote: This plan will be approved and dated {date}.
editor.approveChecks: {count} validation check(s) are still open — you can still approve, but please review them.
editor.regenerateConfirm: Regenerating will discard all edits to this plan. Continue?
editor.regenerateNoTarget: This plan has no recorded calorie target, so it cannot be regenerated. Set the daily target in Plan settings first, or create a new plan for this client.
editor.saveRejected: The plan could not be saved — it may have been approved or sent in another tab, or your account may not have permission. Reload the page and try again.
editor.kcalWarning: Macros suggest ~{est} kcal but option states {stated} kcal
